about: The evidence guide library (v24). Each guide is a markdown draft written from peer-reviewed sources for the clinic to review and edit on GitHub; the app picks up edits the next time it opens online. This file says which guides travel with a request to Claude. Suggest from the report always sends 'always'; when a condition is chosen (or the report is a rehab report: by_tool names the condition for each rehab tool and the label shown, and the report's rehab phase stands in for the stage) it also sends 'rehab' and the condition's guides. The app sends each guide without its '## Sources' section. Guide ids are the file names without .md. A condition's label is what the menu shows (keep it short); its detail goes to Claude with the label. A guide's short name is what the Suggest dialog lists.
